title: bee.mjs dispatcher sweep: sessions and workflow handlers on controlRoot
action: Re-root bee.mjs's ~15 coordination call sites (readSession/resolveSessionId/bindSessionLane/unbindSessionLane at ~474/1248/1478/2133/2298 and workflow gate/plan-rev/handoff handlers) through resolveContext.controlRoot, and hooks/adapter.mjs ctx.root consumers where they feed coordination stores. Sessions created from a worktree register in main's control store (visible to owner-detection). Existing solo-repo behavior byte-identical. Regen inside this cell: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write (+ impact_registry --write if suites changed). Canonical source: skills/bee-hive/templates/.

truths: a session started in a linked worktree is visible in main's session store (topology test, red-first)
prohibitions: no session/workflow write left worktree-local in bee.mjs

verify: node scripts/run_verify.mjs --impacted && node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --check && node scripts/ledger_parity.mjs --check

trace.outcome: bee.mjs dispatcher sweep: ~20 coordination-store call sites (sessions/workflows/handoff-mailbox) re-rooted through controlRootFor(root); state-projection.mjs's matching read side re-rooted in the same landing (msn-18b's own forward note); hooks/adapter.mjs exposes ctx.controlRoot + an exported controlRootFor() primitive for future hook-consumer wiring. Red-first topology proofs in test_cli_state.mjs, test_state_projection.mjs, hooks/test_hook_contracts.mjs; solo/main byte-identical.
deviations: Touched skills/bee-hive/templates/lib/state-projection.mjs (+ its vendored mirrors), which is NOT in this cell's declared `files` list. Justification: msn-18b's own forward-looking note (added in commit a1431448, header of state-projection.mjs) explicitly states the plane-rule gap it deliberately left open can only be closed by 're-rooting bee.mjs's own workflow/lane/handoff-mailbox call sites in the SAME landing as this module's read side — msn-18c's declared scope'. Re-rooting bee.mjs's writes through controlRootFor(root) alone, without also re-rooting state-projection.mjs's listWorkflows/listHandoffMailbox reads, would have made every write-then-rebuild pair in bee.mjs (writeLaneRecordThroughProjection, writeStateRecordThroughProjection, handleStateGate, handleStatePlanRevBump, handleStateHandoffWrite/Adopt) desync: the write lands at controlRoot but the immediately-following rebuild reads bare-root, silently overwriting the legacy projection file with stale/empty data for any granted-worktree caller. Only `listWorkflows(root)`/`listHandoffMailbox(root, ...)` calls were re-rooted; readState/writeState/readLane/writeLane/handoffPath calls (the legacy projection files themselves) were left on the bare root, unchanged — matching the PLANE RULE (workflow/session/handoff-mailbox stores are control-plane; the legacy presentation files stay workspace-local). Proven via a dedicated red-first topology test in test_state_projection.mjs.
